This is causing the `word_count` function to return incorrect results. The issue with `most_common_word` returning an empty string is likely due to the same problem, as it also relies on the output of `tokenize`.

import re

def tokenize(text):
    """Split text into lowercase words, using any whitespace as separator."""
    return re.split(r'\s+', text.lower())
